The '''Fere system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|double]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Fere]], famous for its [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. This system was sometimes known as the '''Ferre system'''.

The [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Fere (star)|Fere]] was the primary body of the system. Around [[190 BBY]], the natives of Fere were wiped out by a plague.
